settings.agentStatus: Show agent status in the status bar
settings.agentStatusHint: Asks claude to report its model, context usage and cost to spekterm. Your own status line keeps working. Applies to sessions started after this change.
settings.languageHint: Applies immediately. Text written by spekterm for the agent stays in English.
settings.autoHibernateHint: Ends the process of a session that has been idle this long, keeping it in the workspace to wake later. The session on screen, a working agent and a shell running a job are never hibernated.

insights.label: Conversation metrics
insights.sourceUnavailable: No transcript source found. Claude Code writes session transcripts under its config directory; set CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR in your shell if you keep it elsewhere.
insights.noData: The transcript source is readable but has nothing in it yet.
insights.error: The last scan failed. Try Rescan.
insights.compareHint: Pick two ranges to put the same number side by side.

stat.noMean: Distributions show the median, never the mean — the tail here is far longer than the centre.

weekHeat.title: Rhythm of the week
weekHeat.blurb: Messages per weekday and hour, in your local time zone.

sitDown.title: How long I sit down for
sitDown.blurb: Each session split wherever nothing happened for over {{minutes}} minutes.
sitDown.activity: An activity is a message I sent or a tool the agent called — not token usage. When the agent runs tools for forty minutes straight, I am still sitting there.
sitDown.source: timestamp (split at gaps over {{minutes}} minutes; activity = messages + tool calls)

length.title: How long I talk
length.source: message text (role=user, after dropping harness-injected turns)

rounds.title: Turns per conversation
rounds.blurb: How many times I spoke in one session.

interrupts.title: When I hit the brakes
interrupts.blurb: Times I stopped the agent mid-run, by day.
interrupts.source: interruptedMessageId on the record (not a text match)

projects.title: Which project takes my words
projects.blurb: Project names are resolved from the transcript's working directory, not from its last value — that one wanders into temp folders.
projects.source: project directory, resolved back to the project root

bash.title: What Bash actually runs
bash.blurb: First word of every Bash command, including the ones subagents ran.
bash.source: tool input command, first token (type=tool_use, name=Bash)

skills.title: Skills I actually use
skills.blurb: Taken from the Skill tool's arguments, not from messages that start with a slash — that count misses almost all of them.

cues.title: Literal cues
cues.blurb: Six literal patterns in what I typed — not a reading of tone. One message can match more than one, so the percentages do not add up to 100%. "Matched nothing" is everything the six patterns missed.
cues.source: message text matched against the rule below (applied at read time)

language.title: Chinese and English
language.blurb: Decided per message by comparing CJK characters against Latin letters. Messages that use both are counted again on the right.
language.source: character classes in the message text

phrases.title: The things I say most
phrases.blurb: Only messages of {{maxChars}} characters or fewer that appear at least {{minCount}} times. This is the one place raw messages appear, and the limits are deliberate.
phrases.source: message text (length under the cap, repeated at least the minimum)

meta.title: Records not counted as mine
meta.ratio: {{percent}}% of user-role records were harness-injected and excluded.

report.label: Qualitative reading
report.blurb: A reading of how you talk to your agent, written by your own claude CLI. Every observation carries a quote taken verbatim from something you actually typed; observations whose quote cannot be found are discarded before you see them.
report.empty: No readings yet. Generating one sends your own messages to Anthropic, so it only ever runs when you ask for it.
report.generating: Reading your messages. This takes a few minutes.
report.rangeNote: This reading covers {{period}}, which is not the range selected on the Numbers tab.

authorize.title: Send these messages to Anthropic?
authorize.blurb: What leaves this machine is the text you typed to your agent. It does not include tool output, file contents from your repositories, or anything your agent wrote. This authorises one run only.
authorize.identity: The reading runs as your own claude login. Credentials sitting in your shell environment, such as an API key or a gateway token, are not passed to it.
authorize.truncated: The range you asked for is larger than one run can carry, so the oldest part has been dropped. The numbers above are what will actually be sent.

meta.discardedNone: every observation carried a verifiable quote

error.cliMissing: The claude command could not be started. It has to be on the PATH your shell uses.
error.delegateFailed: The claude command returned an error. Either it needs you to log in, or your only credential lives in your shell environment, which a reading does not use.
error.delegateTimeout: The reading did not finish in time and was stopped.
error.unparsableReply: The reply could not be read as a reading. Nothing was saved.
error.allClaimsDiscarded: Every observation in this run failed verification, so nothing was saved. This is not an empty reading; none of it could be traced back to something you actually typed.
error.toolUseAttempted: The run tried to use tools, which it is not allowed to do. Nothing was saved.
error.noData: There are no messages in this range to read.

slack.label: Slack
slack.title: Slack connection
slack.description: Detects when someone mentions you in Slack and delivers it to this inbox. You still read it and press send yourself.
slack.notConnected: Not connected yet — the identity comes from the token, there is nothing to fill in.
slack.lookbackHint: How far back to search on startup. Mentions older than this are missed — Slack does not replay events while the app is closed.
slack.endpointCustom: Custom endpoint in use — your credentials are sent here
slack.endpointHint: Only https is accepted. Change this only if you know why: it is where your credentials are sent.
slack.routingHint: Set a routing fallback under Rules, otherwise every mention arrives with no folder to open in.
slack.truncatedBody: [earlier messages in this thread were left out — the text was too long to show in full]
slack.bodyHeader: Thread in #{{channel}}, up to the message that mentioned you:
slack.statusUnconfigured: Not set up yet — paste a user token above.
slack.statusIdle: Working. Nothing new since the last check.
slack.statusNeverRan: Set up, but it has not checked yet.
slack.statusFailureAuth: Your Slack credentials are no longer valid ({{error}}). Mentions are NOT arriving until you paste a new token.
slack.statusFailureTransient: Cannot reach Slack right now ({{error}}). Mentions will arrive on the next check.
slack.statusDeferred_one: {{count}} more mention is waiting — it arrives on the next check.
slack.statusDeferred_other: {{count}} more mentions are waiting — they arrive on the next check.
slack.statusDelivered_one: {{count}} mention arrived on the last check.
slack.statusDelivered_other: {{count}} mentions arrived on the last check.
slack.realtimeConnected: On — new mentions arrive within seconds.
slack.realtimeOff: Off — add an app-level token to get mentions within seconds instead of on the next check.
slack.realtimeDegraded: Interrupted — falling back to the periodic check.
slack.statusFailureScope: Your Slack token is valid but is missing permissions. Add these User Token Scopes and reinstall the app: {{needed}}
slack.statusRateLimited: Slack asked us to slow down. Nothing is wrong with your setup — the next check is at {{time}}.
slack.statusRateLimitedSoon: Slack asked us to slow down. Nothing is wrong with your setup — trying again shortly.
slack.statusFailureScopeUnknown: Your Slack token is valid but is missing permissions ({{error}}). Add the missing User Token Scopes and reinstall the app.
